name: Hand Sword Rhythm
description: Slice boxes to the beat with your hands
howToPlay: Raise both hands in front of the camera — each hand controls its own glowing sword.
Boxes fly toward you in time with the music; slice through them with the correct hand as they reach you.
Missing a box, or slicing it with the wrong hand, breaks your combo.
In multiplayer Versus mode you compete for the higher score; in Co-op mode you and your partner share one synced beat and combine your scores as a team.
rules: Each clean hit builds your combo multiplier; a miss resets it back to zero.
Song, BPM, and difficulty are locked in by whichever player creates the match.
Versus mode: whoever has the higher score when the track ends wins.
Co-op mode: your combined team score is what counts, not who scored more.

name: Motion Tennis
description: Play tennis against a bot using hand tracking to control your racket
howToPlay: Move your hand in front of the camera to control your racket, and swing to hit the ball as it comes toward you.
To serve, show the three finger-count digits in the exact order displayed, before the timer runs out.
While swinging, hold up 1, 2, or 3 fingers to aim your shot left, center, or right — or 5 fingers to smash for extra power.
Play solo against a bot offline, or head-to-head online against a real opponent via Quick Match or a private room.
rules: First to win 2 games takes the match; each game is won by reaching 4 points with at least a 2-point lead (deuce/advantage kicks in past 3-3).
The ball must bounce once on the opponent's side before they return it — a second bounce, or a bounce on the wrong side, costs you the point.
Serve power scales with how many of the 3 finger-count digits you confirm in time — a full 3-for-3 gives you the strongest serve.

name: Motion Pong
description: Classic pong — move your head left and right to control your paddle, and hold up finger-count gestures to trigger special abilities
howToPlay: Move your head left and right — the camera tracks your nose position and mirrors it to your paddle.
Press SPACE, or just tap the screen, to serve when it's your turn.
Hold up finger-count patterns with your hand to trigger special abilities: 5→4→3 for Paddle Boost, 1→2 for Slow-Mo, 3→4→5 for Shield.
Play solo against a bot offline, or challenge a real opponent online via Quick Match or a private room.
rules: First to 7 points wins the match — whoever wins a point serves next.
Each successful paddle hit slightly speeds up the ball, so rallies get faster over time.
Shield deflects one otherwise-lost point back into play instead of ending it, consumed on use.
Slow-Mo slows the ball down for both players at once, not just whoever activated it.
